newsitem.title: USA: MCI says MCI One growing rapidly.
newsitem.headline: MCI says MCI One growing rapidly.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said on Monday that its Network MCI One, which was introduced two months ago, was producing very strong increases in local customers.

Nate Davis, MCI senior vice president for local markets, said that customers of the plan, which puts a number of services together on a single bill, has grown extremely strongly in the last two months.

Davis told a Salomon Brothers investment conference that 1.5 million minutes of local calling time was now being used on MCI's Metro local networks. This is a 50 percent increase every month since the service began early this year.
Davis said lines to customers were growing 100 percent every month, and the number of customers had increased by 250 percent every month since the service began. He did not elaborate.
